AC amendment (gap-analysis): verdict_adapter shape — assert each harness's verdict_adapter has a defined name/path reference shape (not a bare/empty/placeholder scalar), so sc-3 can deterministically resolve adapters.
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python3 -c "import yaml; h=yaml.safe_load(open('plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml'))['harnesses']; assert all(x.get('verdict_adapter') and (isinstance(x['verdict_adapter'],dict) or (isinstance(x['verdict_adapter'],str) and x['verdict_adapter'].strip())) for x in h); print('OK')"
